definitions.gloss: to reel in; to roll up; to wind up
definitions.explanation: To wind something around a spool, reel, or similar device, gathering it up by rolling or winding. Used for thread, tape, film, fishing line, and similar materials.

examples.japanese: リール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{釣|つ}り{糸|いと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{取|と}った。
examples.english: I reeled in the fishing line with the reel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦ホース→ホース：25876_hoosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{取|と}って⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: I rolled up the hose after using it and put it away.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wind, to roll) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take). The ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ component adds the sense of gathering or collecting the wound material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{取|と}る: to wind up thread
- ⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{取|と}る: to wind up tape
- ⟦ホース→ホース：25876_hoosu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{取|と}る: to roll up a hose
- {釣|つ}り{糸|いと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{取|と}る: to reel in fishing line
- ⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{取|と}る: to wind up film

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to wind, to roll — the base verb; broader usage including wrapping around something
- ⟦{巻|ま}き{上|あ}げる→巻き上げる：20304_makiageru⟧: to roll up, to hoist — emphasizes upward motion; also means to swindle (colloquial)
- ⟦{手繰|たぐ}る→手繰る：30734_taguru⟧: to pull in hand over hand — pulling rope or line toward oneself without winding

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the object being wound up.
